title: Energy kabhi khatam NAHI hoti... toh "Energy Crisis" kya hai?
description: Season 2 Episode 16: Energy is never destroyed — it spreads out as heat and becomes useless. Energy crisis = useful-energy crisis.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 5 (conservation of energy) → seeds Ch 11 Thermodynamics (2nd law, entropy)
hook_text: Energy kabhi khatam nahi hoti. Toh 'Energy Crisis' kya bakwaas hai? ⚡
concept: Energy is never destroyed — it spreads out as heat and becomes useless. Energy crisis = useful-energy crisis.
on_screen_cues: "KE → heat (brakes, tyres, air)" → "Total energy: SAME" → "Useful energy: ↓" → "ENTROPY (coming in Season 3)" → "NCERT XI Ch 5 → Ch 11"
pinned_comment: Ek cheez batao jo 100% energy ko wapas useful bana de. (Spoiler: nahi hai. Kyun? — Season 3 mein)
suggested_titles: "Energy khatam nahi hoti toh 'energy crisis' kya hai?" / "Brake lagane pe energy kahan jaati hai?"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [confused] Chintu, energy na banti hai na khatam hoti hai. Toh "energy bachao", "energy crisis" kya bakwaas hai?
Chintu: [laughs] Sabse smart sawaal!
Gudiya: [sarcastic] Thank you. Jawab?
Chintu: [excited] Gaadi 100 ki speed pe hai. Brake lagao. Kinetic energy kahan gayi?
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Khatam ho gayi...
Chintu: [deadpan] Wrong.
Gudiya: [sighs] Phir wrong.
Chintu: [cheerfully] Brake ke pad garam ho gaye. Tyre garam. Hawa garam. Puri energy... GARMI ban gayi!
Gudiya: [curious] Toh energy bachi hai! Phir crisis kya hai?
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Woh garmi ab poori hawa mein phail gayi hai. Usse wapas ikattha karke gaadi chala sakte ho?
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Nahi...
Chintu: [excited] Yahi hai! Energy khatam nahi hoti... USEFUL energy khatam hoti hai! Ikatthi energy phail jaati hai, aur phaili energy kaam ki nahi rehti.
Gudiya: [gasps] Matlab petrol jalana energy ko destroy nahi karta... use bekaar bana deta hai!
Chintu: [elated] EXACTLY! Universe mein energy fixed hai. Par har second thodi aur "bekaar" ho rahi hai.
Gudiya: [whispers] Yeh thoda dark hai.
Chintu: [mischievously] Isko ENTROPY bolte hain. Thermodynamics ka boss. Uski kahani aage aayegi.
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, rocket space mein kis cheez ko push karke aage jaata hai? Wahan toh kuch hai hi nahi!
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
